bullets: Added graphs to your personal Poker stats: a bankroll-over-time chart, a win/loss chart per game, and a head-to-head breakdown of who you've won the most from (and lost the most to).
The group Hall of Fame now has a full sortable leaderboard table, a ranked net-winnings chart, and a games-per-month activity chart.

Adding a grocery or pantry item you already have now tops up the existing item instead of creating a duplicate row — even when the unit doesn't match exactly (e.g. "cups" vs "bag" now shows as a combined quantity you can edit).
Marking a grocery item as bought now moves it to your pantry with a quick animation instead of freezing the screen while it saves.
The edit screen for a grocery/pantry item now lets you edit every quantity on it, not just the first one.
Added a "Quick Meal" feature that is more flexible than the recipe option, allowing users to adjust what quantity of ingredients they are using each time they make it.
